commits.message:
feat(profile): integrate CompanySearchSelect in onboarding forms

- Replaced traditional input fields for company selection with CompanySearchSelect in onboarding forms for Bench Sales, Consultant, Employer, and Recruiter roles.
- Enhanced user experience by allowing users to search and select companies more efficiently.
- Updated related components to utilize the new CompanySearchSelect for consistent functionality across profile editing and onboarding processes.
- Improved error handling and validation for company selection in forms.

feat(profile): enhance SubmissionSnapshot and profile helpers

- Integrated LinkedIn URL resolution in SubmissionSnapshot to maintain current value during edits.
- Updated resolveStatus function to remove unnecessary extras parameter for cleaner code.
- Improved handling of client name in HermesDraftsReview to ensure default value is an empty string when undefined.
- Refactored conditional rendering in Profile component for LinkedInProfileAutofill to enhance clarity and maintainability.

feat(profile): implement profile import review modal and enhance autofill functionality

- Added ProfileImportReviewModal for users to review and confirm imported profile details before saving.
- Integrated ProfileCompletionAutofill component to streamline profile autofill process from LinkedIn and resumes.
- Updated Profile component to utilize the new autofill functionality, enhancing user experience during profile completion.
- Introduced types for profile import handling to improve data structure and validation.
- Enhanced error handling and user feedback mechanisms during the profile import process.

feat(profile): add status selection to profile modals

- Introduced a status selection feature in BenchSalesEditProfileModal, ConsultantEditProfileModal, RecruiterEditProfileModal, and ServiceProviderEditCompanyProfileModal.
- Implemented shared PROFILE_HEADER_STATUS_OPTIONS for consistent status handling across different profile types.
- Enhanced form handling to include status in submissions, improving data integrity during profile updates.
- Updated SubmissionSnapshot to reflect the current status from the profile overview.
- Refactored profile header helpers to streamline status retrieval logic.

feat(profile): enhance service provider profile components and modals

- Refactored CompanyDetails component to utilize SERVICE_PROVIDER_WORK_TYPE_OPTIONS for target users.
- Updated ProfileContent to include new save functions for service provider expertise and contact booking.
- Enhanced ProfileHeader to display work type information and added fullProfileJson prop for better data handling.
- Introduced ServiceProviderEditContactBookingModal and ServiceProviderEditExpertiseModal for improved editing capabilities.
- Improved ServiceProviderCompanyDetailsCard to display comprehensive business information and allow editing for owners.
- Enhanced ServiceProviderContactBookingTab with edit functionality for contact details and availability.
- Updated various input fields and validation messages for clarity and consistency across modals.

feat(consultants): introduce reusable AddConsultantModal and shared mappers

- Added a new shared AddConsultantModal component with profile, rates, engagement, visibility, and notes tabs.
- Introduced bidirectional mappers between AddConsultantModalFormValues and bench hotlist / employer talent network shapes.
- Refactored BenchSalesAddConsultantModal and AddBenchHotlistConsultantModal to use the shared modal and mappers.
- Replaced inline status selects across profile edit modals with a new ProfileHeaderStatusSelect that supports custom statuses.
- Fixed slash-separated client focus names in recruiter edit profile defaults.

feat(profile): drive service provider categories from master data

- Replaced hardcoded SP_SERVICE_CATEGORIES with master-data-backed service category options in company profile and service modals.
- Added service category id coercion, name resolution, and sanitization helpers for string/number/object shapes.
- Introduced companyProfileFormToHeaderPayload and featuredServiceToApiPayload mappers for consistent API payloads.
- Updated useMasterData to unwrap nested response envelopes via new unwrapMasterData utility.
- Persisted serviceCategoryId on featured services and aligned save mutations to send numeric category ids.
- Hid Work Type meta for service providers in ProfileHeader.

feat(profile): enhance education and work experience sections with sorting and UI updates

- Updated EducationSection to display a simplified "No data" message when no education entries are present.
- Enhanced WorkExperienceTimeline to support asynchronous save operations and improved data handling for current roles.
- Introduced sorting functionality for education and work experience entries based on recency.
- Added utility functions for comparing and sorting education and work experience data.
- Refactored WorkExperienceModal to utilize a new multi-select component for employment types and improved submission handling.
- Added comprehensive tests for timeline ordering of work experience and education data.

feat(profile): enhance professional summary component and related functionalities

- Refactored ProfessionalSummary component to support expanded/collapsed views for long summaries.
- Updated EditProfessionalSummaryModal to streamline content generation and save operations.
- Introduced professionalSummaryGenerationFacts for improved data handling during summary generation.
- Removed deprecated benchOverviewForProfessionalSummary helper and integrated workExperienceForProfessionalSummary for better data consistency.
- Added comprehensive tests for professional summary helpers to ensure functionality and correctness.
- Updated various profile tabs to utilize the new professional summary structure and data flow.

refactor(profile): rename hiringStatus to status and update related functionalities

- Changed the property name from hiringStatus to status in EmployerCompanyProfileFormValues for consistency.
- Updated employerHeaderStatus function to handle status retrieval from overview.
- Modified toFormValues function to use the new status property.
- Adjusted form submission logic and input field names to reflect the renaming.
- Enhanced resolveStatus function to prioritize statusText when retrieving employer status.

feat(profile): add fullProfileJson support to employer profile components

- Introduced fullProfileJson prop to EmployerCompanyDetailsSection and EmployerEditCompanyProfileModal for enhanced data handling.
- Updated toFormValues function to utilize fullProfileJson for tagline retrieval.
- Enhanced ProfileHeader to conditionally display employer tagline from fullProfileJson.
- Modified profile header helpers to accommodate new employerTagline property for improved subtitle resolution.

feat(profile): update BenchSalesEditProfileModal with timezone selection and remove remote preference

- Added TimezoneSelectField to allow users to select their working timezone.
- Removed remote preference handling from the profile modal to streamline the form.
- Updated toFormValues function to reflect the changes in profile data structure.
- Enhanced ProfileHeader to conditionally render based on user roles, including bench sales.

feat(profile): refactor city and state selection in profile modals

- Replaced direct geocoding logic in ConsultantEditProfileModal, EditLocationPreferencesModal, and EditSubmissionSnapshotModal with a reusable hook for paired city and state selection.
- Updated PlacesAutocompleteField to support additional suggestion parameters for improved address handling.
- Removed redundant city and state parsing functions and streamlined the form submission process.
- Added unit tests for new city-state pairing functionality to ensure accuracy and reliability.

feat(consultants): enhance AddConsultantModal with duplicate detection and improved status handling

- Introduced DuplicateConsultantsDialog to alert users of potential duplicate entries when adding a consultant.
- Updated status mappings in addConsultantEmployerMappers.ts for consistency with new status labels.
- Enhanced BenchSalesAddConsultantModal to handle duplicate candidates and display relevant messages.
- Added unit tests for managedConsultantForm to ensure accurate data handling and submission logic.
- Refactored AddConsultantModal to support new visa requirements and improved form submission handling.

feat(network): restructure network routes and enhance dashboard components

- Removed the redundant network route from public routes and reintroduced it in the private section for better organization.
- Added a new NetworkDashboard component to provide users with an overview of their network activities and connections.
- Implemented a TemplateLibraryModal for managing message templates within the network context.
- Created DiscoverConnections and DiscoverConnectionSidebar components to facilitate connection discovery and management.
- Updated NetworkSidebar to utilize dynamic navigation items for improved user experience.
- Enhanced navigation menu links to conditionally redirect unauthenticated users to the login page.

feat(network): add ConfirmDeleteModal for deletion confirmations across components

- Introduced ConfirmDeleteModal component for consistent deletion confirmation dialogs.
- Integrated ConfirmDeleteModal into DiscoverConnectionSidebar, FollowUps, RelationshipActivity, RelationshipFollowUps, RelationshipNotes, RelationshipOpportunities, and RelationshipSidebar for managing deletions.
- Updated state management in respective components to handle deletion logic and modal visibility.

feat(consultants): add AddConsultantBackgroundFields component for enhanced consultant background input

- Introduced AddConsultantBackgroundFields component to manage LinkedIn URL, current employer, professional summary, work history, and resume uploads.
- Integrated useFieldArray for dynamic education and certification entries.
- Implemented validation for LinkedIn URL and file uploads, ensuring proper formats and size limits.
- Updated AddConsultantModal to include AddConsultantBackgroundFields for a comprehensive consultant onboarding experience.
- Enhanced form handling with improved state management for resume uploads and error messaging.

feat(network): enhance relationship management with new components and updates

- Introduced RelationshipSidebar and RelationshipQuickActions for improved relationship interactions.
- Updated NetworkDashboard and Insights components to utilize the new RelationshipSidebar for displaying relationship details.
- Enhanced DiscoverConnections and RelationshipDirectory to integrate relationship management features.
- Refactored existing components to support new relationship functionalities, including follow-ups and messaging.
- Improved UI elements for better user experience across network-related components.

feat(broadcast): introduce broadcast management components and routing updates

- Added new components for managing broadcasts, including BroadcastChrome, BroadcastDetailViews, and various UI elements for displaying broadcast statistics and interactions.
- Implemented ImportRecruitersView for importing recruiter contacts via CSV and text input.
- Created NewBroadcastView and NewRequirementView for launching new broadcasts and requirements, enhancing user experience with guided steps and validation.
- Updated routes to include new broadcast-related paths and reorganized existing routes for better structure.
- Enhanced overall UI for broadcast management, including real-time updates and improved navigation.

Bring dev-duplicate up to date with the latest dev.
